title: Close the QA V2 PDF request envelope and Windows first-install blockers
objective: Preserve the fixed PDF evidence coverage while removing repeated provider-only metadata that pushed QA V2 past 64 KB, verify real provider dispatch on the same frozen 15 questions, and make a clean Windows dependency installation succeed under a CP936 locale.
approval_ref: The user explicitly allowed real model calls, directed item 2 to be solved, item 4 to be attempted, item 3 to be resubmitted, and asked to focus on PDF while deferring quality, DPAPI and customer migration gates.
notes: Use the same immutable Kapolei run and frozen 15 questions; do not tune retrieval between questions.
Keep exact source text and evidence identity in the provider request while retaining file/page/path/geometry locally for validation and response enrichment.
Use a disposable database and encrypted-credential clone for live calls, make no automatic retry, and remove the clone after settlement checks.
Do not claim that contract-valid rate or construction accuracy improved merely because dispatch now succeeds.
